_comment: Unified catalog: merged from legacy src893/staging (28 top-level sections, 516 lines) + architectural-refactor additions (cloudSync, cloudSyncBehavior, launchLogs, library, navigation, playButton, saveFolder, security, settings, + new launcher toasts). The overlay policy is current-wins-on-conflict so new code's expected labels survive. Legacy top-level sections (accountSwitch, storageSettings, ubisoftAuth, etc.) are preserved as-is since their consumer components migrate unchanged.

captureLogs._comment: CaptureLogsSection (QAM Settings tab, rendered directly below CleanupSection) + CaptureLogsConfirmModal. One button calls the capture_logs RPC, which zips every log, state file and diagnostic report into the user's Downloads folder so it can be attached to a bug report. The returned path is kept on screen after the toast expires, rendered dir=ltr with word-break so a long POSIX path stays readable in a ~300px row. partialNote is genuinely pluralised via {{count}}, so both forms must exist; bundleInfo uses {{files}} instead to stay out of i18next's plural machinery.

cloudSyncBehavior._comment: Settings panel letting the user pick, per store, how cloud save sync failures should be surfaced. The five store_label entries mirror the rows rendered by CloudSyncBehaviorPanel.tsx. Microsoft deliberately omitted. XCloud streaming has no local save to sync.

cloudSync._comment: Toast strings emitted by the launcher when a cloud sync fails. The error placeholder is resolved through cloudSync.error.<code> via the backend payload's error_i18n_key field.

launchLogs._comment: LaunchLogsModal strings. The modal opens from the unifideck://show-logs/<launch_id> toast action, attached to launcher-failure toasts (circuit breaker + LauncherError). Reads per-launch archived logs from ~/.local/share/unifideck/launches/<launch_id>.log and renders them with level-based color coding.

settings._comment: UnifideckSettingsPanel action-type controls that aren't covered by more specific components (LanguageSelector, CloudSyncBehaviorPanel). refreshAll is a fire-and-forget button that triggers sync_all() across every registered store; the Library view shows the sync progress via its own subscription to SYNC_PROGRESS events.

refreshAll.startedBody: Syncing all stores in the background.

saveFolder._comment: SaveFolderModal strings. The modal opens from the unifideck://open-save-folder/<store>/<game_id> toast action, typically surfaced on cloud sync failures where the user wants to inspect what's actually stored locally. count and size are interpolated; truncated shows only when the result was capped.

library._comment: Per-game UI affordances rendered in the Library view, including the circuit-breaker badge and force-launch / reset controls when launches fail repeatedly.

circuitBreaker._comment: Surface for the launch-failure circuit breaker. Badge appears only when failures within the configured window reach circuit_breaker.failures_threshold (default 3 in 600s). Force launch arms a one-shot bypass; Reset wipes the failure history entirely.
